meta.title: Awakening
meta.description: It is only natural that the head chef should be the first to taste a banquet.

units.rawText: At the Rossum Sector, in the Data Center.
units.displayText: At the Rossum Sector, in the Data Center.

units.rawText: I... this is...
units.displayText: I... this is...

spans.text: I... this is...

units.rawText: Is it... over?
units.displayText: Is it... over?

spans.text: Is it... over?

units.rawText: Hannah!
units.displayText: Hannah!

spans.text: Hannah!

units.displayText: Turing is standing off to the side, but she doesn't wait for Hannah to approach before launching herself at her.

spans.text: Turing is standing off to the side, but she doesn't wait for Hannah to approach before launching herself at her.

units.rawText: Hannah, you're awake at last!
units.displayText: Hannah, you're awake at last!

spans.text: Hannah, you're awake at last!

units.rawText: Ah, this feeling... This is the real...
units.displayText: Ah, this feeling... This is the real...

spans.text: Ah, this feeling... This is the real...

units.rawText: Hm? What's real?
units.displayText: Hm? What's real?

spans.text: Hm? What's real?

units.rawText: The dreamlike haze recedes, and Hannah reflexively hugs Turing tightly before easing up a little in embarrassment.
units.displayText: The dreamlike haze recedes, and Hannah reflexively hugs Turing tightly before easing up a little in embarrassment.

spans.text: The dreamlike haze recedes, and Hannah reflexively hugs Turing tightly before easing up a little in embarrassment.

units.rawText: Upon sensing that Hannah is letting go, Turing immediately hugs her even tighter. Hannah's jaw drops, but nothing comes out. Instead she clings to Turing and buries her face in Turing's neck.
units.displayText: Upon sensing that Hannah is letting go, Turing immediately hugs her even tighter. Hannah's jaw drops, but nothing comes out. Instead she clings to Turing and buries her face in Turing's neck.

units.rawText: ...Thank goodness.
units.displayText: ...Thank goodness.

units.rawText: I'm alright. How long were you awake?
units.displayText: I'm alright. How long were you awake?

spans.text: I'm alright. How long were you awake?

units.rawText: Not long. Miss Sol saved me.
units.displayText: Not long. Miss Sol saved me.

spans.text: Not long. Miss Sol saved me.

units.rawText: Thank you very much, Sol.
units.displayText: Thank you very much, Sol.

spans.text: Thank you very much, Sol.

units.rawText: Aw, no need to be so stiff. I mean, Turing helped bandage me up in the past.
units.displayText: Aw, no need to be so stiff. I mean, Turing helped bandage me up in the past.

spans.text: Aw, no need to be so stiff. I mean, Turing helped bandage me up in the past.

units.rawText: Plus, you were the key to the whole thing. You did great, Hannah.
units.displayText: Plus, you were the key to the whole thing. You did great, Hannah.

spans.text: Plus, you were the key to the whole thing. You did great, Hannah.

units.displayText: Hannah's ears twitch, and she gently nods.

spans.text: Hannah's ears twitch, and she gently nods.

units.rawText: What about Odile?
units.displayText: What about Odile?

spans.text: What about Odile?

units.rawText: Croque says that she's been dealt with. She's planning to leave the cannon platform and meet up with us.
units.displayText: Croque says that she's been dealt with. She's planning to leave the cannon platform and meet up with us.

spans.text: Croque says that she's been dealt with. She's planning to leave the cannon platform and meet up with us.

units.rawText: That thing is no joke... I heard it vaporized like, 80% of the Entropics in the Null Area.
units.displayText: That thing is no joke... I heard it vaporized like, 80% of the Entropics in the Null Area.

spans.text: That thing is no joke... I heard it vaporized like, 80% of the Entropics in the Null Area.

units.rawText: Anna verified it too. Odile was completely destroyed by the shot. There was nothing left of her.
units.displayText: Anna verified it too. Odile was completely destroyed by the shot. There was nothing left of her.

spans.text: Anna verified it too. Odile was completely destroyed by the shot. There was nothing left of her.

units.rawText: Beepbeepbeep.
units.displayText: Beepbeepbeep.

spans.text: Beepbeepbeep.

units.rawText: Ah, it's a message from the Prof.
units.displayText: Ah, it's a message from the Prof.

spans.text: Ah, it's a message from the Prof.

units.rawText: I'll head outside to take it, you guys go take care of each other, okay?
units.displayText: I'll head outside to take it, you guys go take care of each other, okay?

spans.text: I'll head outside to take it, you guys go take care of each other, okay?

units.displayText: Sol makes a quick, stylish exit.

spans.text: Sol makes a quick, stylish exit.

units.rawText: Miss Sol—(Sigh) Her wounds will open up again if she runs so fast.
units.displayText: Miss Sol—(Sigh) Her wounds will open up again if she runs so fast.

spans.text: Miss Sol—(Sigh) Her wounds will open up again if she runs so fast.

units.rawText: You've gotten better at healing, Turing.
units.displayText: You've gotten better at healing, Turing.

spans.text: You've gotten better at healing, Turing.

units.rawText: I had to do it so many times over such a short span of time... Fortunately you taught me how to deal with situations like that.
units.displayText: I had to do it so many times over such a short span of time... Fortunately you taught me how to deal with situations like that.

spans.text: I had to do it so many times over such a short span of time... Fortunately you taught me how to deal with situations like that.

units.rawText: I'd like to say the same thing too. I'm glad you taught me how to handle such situations, Turing.
units.displayText: I'd like to say the same thing too. I'm glad you taught me how to handle such situations, Turing.

spans.text: I'd like to say the same thing too. I'm glad you taught me how to handle such situations, Turing.

units.rawText: Hannah...
units.displayText: Hannah...

spans.text: Hannah...

units.rawText: In the past, I was always afraid that if I didn't do well enough, I wouldn't be able to live up to the choice you made.
units.displayText: In the past, I was always afraid that if I didn't do well enough, I wouldn't be able to live up to the choice you made.

spans.text: In the past, I was always afraid that if I didn't do well enough, I wouldn't be able to live up to the choice you made.

units.rawText: But now, I think things aren't so complicated. I just want to say... Thank you for choosing me back then.
units.displayText: But now, I think things aren't so complicated. I just want to say... Thank you for choosing me back then.

spans.text: But now, I think things aren't so complicated. I just want to say... Thank you for choosing me back then.

units.rawText: That's why I can stand here now and say I choose you, all over again, of my own will.
units.displayText: That's why I can stand here now and say I choose you, all over again, of my own will.

spans.text: That's why I can stand here now and say I choose you, all over again, of my own will.

units.rawText: I... I feel the same way, Hannah.
units.displayText: I... I feel the same way, Hannah.

spans.text: I... I feel the same way, Hannah.

units.rawText: Their hands press quietly to each other, as closely intertwined and inseparable as a Mobius strip.
units.displayText: Their hands press quietly to each other, as closely intertwined and inseparable as a Mobius strip.

spans.text: Their hands press quietly to each other, as closely intertwined and inseparable as a Mobius strip.

units.rawText: On the other side, near Sanctifier Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: On the other side, near Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

spans.text: On the other side, near Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: ...And that's what happened. Turing and Hannah are okay too.
units.displayText: ...And that's what happened. Turing and Hannah are okay too.

spans.text: ...And that's what happened. Turing and Hannah are okay too.

units.rawText: How about yourself, Sol?
units.displayText: How about yourself, Sol?

spans.text: How about yourself, Sol?

units.rawText: Well, of course I'm also okay... basically! Hehe.
units.displayText: Well, of course I'm also okay... basically! Hehe.

spans.text: Well, of course I'm also okay... basically! Hehe.

units.rawText: Your immunity program stopped working, many of your motive modules are non-functional, and you even have damage from overloading your neural cloud!
units.displayText: Your immunity program stopped working, many of your motive modules are non-functional, and you even have damage from overloading your neural cloud!

spans.text: Your immunity program stopped working, many of your motive modules are non-functional, and you even have damage from overloading your neural cloud!

units.rawText: If you call that okay, then would you still be healthy if I sent you to Rise as a specimen?
units.displayText: If you call that okay, then would you still be healthy if I sent you to Rise as a specimen?

spans.text: If you call that okay, then would you still be healthy if I sent you to Rise as a specimen?

units.rawText: But you're here, aren't you... Okay, quit glaring at me, I give, I give.

units.rawText: Humph.
units.displayText: Humph.

spans.text: Humph.

units.rawText: How about the Prof? How are things on your end?

spans.text: How about the Prof? How are things on your end?

units.rawText: Croque wiped out all the Entropics surrounding us with the railgun. The Sanctifiers are taking care of the remnants in the distance.
units.displayText: Croque wiped out all the Entropics surrounding us with the railgun. The Sanctifiers are taking care of the remnants in the distance.

spans.text: Croque wiped out all the Entropics surrounding us with the railgun. The Sanctifiers are taking care of the remnants in the distance.

spans.text: Faith has verified that the crisis at the Rossum Sector is over and has returned to report to the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: As for us, we'll reach the Rossum Sector soon and meet up with you.
units.displayText: As for us, we'll reach the Rossum Sector soon and meet up with you.

spans.text: As for us, we'll reach the Rossum Sector soon and meet up with you.

units.rawText: Sweet! Time for us all to celebrate!
units.displayText: Sweet! Time for us all to celebrate!

spans.text: Sweet! Time for us all to celebrate!

units.rawText: Don't just think of messing around. We still need to help Hannah rebuild the Rossum Sector.
units.displayText: Don't just think of messing around. We still need to help Hannah rebuild the Rossum Sector.

spans.text: Don't just think of messing around. We still need to help Hannah rebuild the Rossum Sector.

units.rawText: At the very least, we need to rebuild the firewall and ensure the Oasis' safety.
units.displayText: At the very least, we need to rebuild the firewall and ensure the Oasis' safety.

spans.text: At the very least, we need to rebuild the firewall and ensure the Oasis' safety.

units.rawText: Yes, yes, I know that, no need to be so stern, Anna.
units.displayText: Yes, yes, I know that, no need to be so stern, Anna.

spans.text: Yes, yes, I know that, no need to be so stern, Anna.

units.rawText: That's Antonina to you.
units.displayText: That's Antonina to you.

spans.text: That's Antonina to you.

units.rawText: Still, about the firewall... The Entropics popped Rossum's firewall pretty much instantly.
units.displayText: Still, about the firewall... The Entropics popped Rossum's firewall pretty much instantly.

spans.text: Still, about the firewall... The Entropics popped Rossum's firewall pretty much instantly.

units.rawText: But when I was running around inside the sector, I got the feeling that Hannah's fortifications were really sturdy. The walls, the buildings, they were all solid.
units.displayText: But when I was running around inside the sector, I got the feeling that Hannah's fortifications were really sturdy. The walls, the buildings, they were all solid.

spans.text: But when I was running around inside the sector, I got the feeling that Hannah's fortifications were really sturdy. The walls, the buildings, they were all solid.

units.rawText: How the heck did Odile overwhelm them so quickly?
units.displayText: How the heck did Odile overwhelm them so quickly?

spans.text: How the heck did Odile overwhelm them so quickly?

units.rawText: Indeed. Odile's tactics this time were comprehensive and her grasp of intelligence was far beyond our expectations.
units.displayText: Indeed. Odile's tactics this time were comprehensive and her grasp of intelligence was far beyond our expectations.

spans.text: Indeed. Odile's tactics this time were comprehensive and her grasp of intelligence was far beyond our expectations.

units.displayText: Considering she was originally just a former Sector Administrator, and of a small sector like Pierides...

spans.text: Considering she was originally just a former Sector Administrator, and of a small sector like Pierides...

units.rawText: Was she blessed by her Entropic "master" or something, which made her grow?

units.displayText: Do you have any input on this, Professor?
